name: Claude Usage — Official Cost per Developer (layer 3)

header.content:
# Claude usage — official daily cost per developer (layer 3)

Anthropic's own per-user usage and cost figures, imported once a day by the **claude-usage-connector** workflow as business events (`event.type = "claude.usage.daily"`, one event per user × product × model × UTC day × source). Billing-grade and complete across claude.ai chat, Cowork, Design, Claude Code (CLI, Desktop and web) — not only the machines where the layer 1/2 hooks are installed. All tiles cover the **last 30 usage days** (coverage: last 7).

kpi_cost.title: Official cost — last 30 usage days
kpi_cost.query:
fetch bizevents, from: now() - 45d
| filter event.type == "claude.usage.daily"
| filter coalesce(org.id, "") != "demo-sample"  // demo rows loaded from csv-import/sample.csv
| filter usage.date >= formatTimestamp(now() - 30d, format: "yyyy-MM-dd", timezone: "UTC")
| dedup dedup.key, sort: {timestamp desc}
| summarize cost_usd = sum(cost_usd)
kpi_cost.description: sum(cost_usd) over deduped claude.usage.daily events, usage.date in the last 30 days

kpi_devs.title: Developers with usage
kpi_devs.query:
fetch bizevents, from: now() - 45d
| filter event.type == "claude.usage.daily"
| filter coalesce(org.id, "") != "demo-sample"  // demo rows loaded from csv-import/sample.csv
| filter usage.date >= formatTimestamp(now() - 30d, format: "yyyy-MM-dd", timezone: "UTC")
| dedup dedup.key, sort: {timestamp desc}
| filter isNotNull(user.email)
| summarize developers = countDistinct(user.email)
kpi_devs.description: countDistinct(user.email); org-level api rows (null e-mail) excluded

kpi_tokens.title: Tokens — last 30 usage days
kpi_tokens.query:
fetch bizevents, from: now() - 45d
| filter event.type == "claude.usage.daily"
| filter coalesce(org.id, "") != "demo-sample"  // demo rows loaded from csv-import/sample.csv
| filter usage.date >= formatTimestamp(now() - 30d, format: "yyyy-MM-dd", timezone: "UTC")
| dedup dedup.key, sort: {timestamp desc}
| summarize tokens = sum(tokens.total)

kpi_latest.title: Latest usage day imported
kpi_latest.query:
fetch bizevents, from: now() - 45d
| filter event.type == "claude.usage.daily"
| filter coalesce(org.id, "") != "demo-sample"  // demo rows loaded from csv-import/sample.csv
| dedup dedup.key, sort: {timestamp desc}
| summarize latest_usage_day = max(usage.date)
| fields latest_usage_day
kpi_latest.description: max(usage.timestamp) across all sources; see the freshness table for the per-source view

daily_cost.title: Daily cost by usage day, stacked by product (USD)
daily_cost.query:
fetch bizevents, from: now() - 45d
| filter event.type == "claude.usage.daily"
| filter coalesce(org.id, "") != "demo-sample"  // demo rows loaded from csv-import/sample.csv
| filter usage.date >= formatTimestamp(now() - 30d, format: "yyyy-MM-dd", timezone: "UTC")
| dedup dedup.key, sort: {timestamp desc}
| makeTimeseries cost_usd = sum(cost_usd), by: {product}, time: toTimestamp(usage.timestamp), interval: 1d, from: now() - 30d, to: now()
daily_cost.description: makeTimeseries over toTimestamp(usage.timestamp) (the usage day), interval 1d, by product

top10.title: Top 10 developers by cost, split by product (USD)
top10.query:
fetch bizevents, from: now() - 45d
| filter event.type == "claude.usage.daily"
| filter coalesce(org.id, "") != "demo-sample"  // demo rows loaded from csv-import/sample.csv
| filter usage.date >= formatTimestamp(now() - 30d, format: "yyyy-MM-dd", timezone: "UTC")
| dedup dedup.key, sort: {timestamp desc}
| filter isNotNull(user.email)
| summarize {
    total_usd = sum(cost_usd),
    claude_code = sum(if(product == "claude_code", cost_usd, else: 0.0)),
    chat = sum(if(product == "chat", cost_usd, else: 0.0)),
    cowork = sum(if(product == "cowork", cost_usd, else: 0.0)),
    design = sum(if(product == "design", cost_usd, else: 0.0)),
    api_other = sum(if(product == "api" or product == "other", cost_usd, else: 0.0))
  }, by: {user.email}
| sort total_usd desc
| limit 10
| fieldsRemove total_usd
top10.description: bar length = total official cost in the last 30 usage days; stack = product

cost_per_dev.title: Cost per developer — last 30 usage days
cost_per_dev.query:
fetch bizevents, from: now() - 45d
| filter event.type == "claude.usage.daily"
| filter coalesce(org.id, "") != "demo-sample"  // drop the sample.csv demo rows
| filter usage.date >= formatTimestamp(now() - 30d, format: "yyyy-MM-dd", timezone: "UTC")
| dedup dedup.key, sort: {timestamp desc}
| summarize {
    cost_usd = sum(cost_usd),
    tokens_total = sum(tokens.total),
    requests = sum(requests),
    days_active = countDistinct(usage.date),
    sources = collectDistinct(source)
  }, by: {user.email}
| fieldsAdd usd_per_1m_tokens = if(tokens_total > 0, cost_usd / tokens_total * 1000000, else: 0)
| sort cost_usd desc
cost_per_dev.description: connector/dql/cost-per-developer-30d.dql — requests is null for Console sources (not exposed by that API)

tokens_product_model.title: Tokens by product × model, stacked by token type
tokens_product_model.query:
fetch bizevents, from: now() - 45d
| filter event.type == "claude.usage.daily"
| filter coalesce(org.id, "") != "demo-sample"  // demo rows loaded from csv-import/sample.csv
| filter usage.date >= formatTimestamp(now() - 30d, format: "yyyy-MM-dd", timezone: "UTC")
| dedup dedup.key, sort: {timestamp desc}
| summarize {
    input = sum(tokens.input),
    output = sum(tokens.output),
    cache_read = sum(tokens.cache_read),
    cache_creation = sum(tokens.cache_creation),
    total = sum(tokens.total)
  }, by: {product, model}
| sort total desc
| limit 25
| fieldsAdd product_model = concat(product, " · ", model)
| fields product_model, input, output, cache_read, cache_creation
tokens_product_model.description: top 25 product × model pairs by tokens.total, last 30 usage days (connector/dql/tokens-by-product-model.dql)

coverage_hdr.content: ### Coverage — official (layer 3 bizevents) vs observed (layer 2 Claude Code logs), claude_code, last 7 usage days

kpi_coverage.title: Observed / official tokens
kpi_coverage.query:
fetch bizevents, from: now() - 10d
| filter event.type == "claude.usage.daily" and product == "claude_code"
| filter coalesce(org.id, "") != "demo-sample"  // demo rows loaded from csv-import/sample.csv
| filter usage.date >= formatTimestamp(now() - 7d, format: "yyyy-MM-dd", timezone: "UTC")
| dedup dedup.key, sort: {timestamp desc}
| summarize official_tokens = sum(tokens.total)
| append [
    fetch logs, from: now() - 7d
    | filter event.name == "api_request" and in(service.name, {"claude-code", "claude-code-desktop"})
    | summarize observed_tokens = sum(toLong(input_tokens) + toLong(output_tokens) + toLong(cache_read_tokens) + toLong(cache_creation_tokens))
  ]
| summarize official_tokens = sum(official_tokens), observed_tokens = sum(observed_tokens)
| fieldsAdd coverage_pct = if(official_tokens > 0, observed_tokens * 100.0 / official_tokens, else: 0.0)
| fields coverage_pct
kpi_coverage.description: layer 2 api_request tokens ÷ layer 3 official claude_code tokens, last 7 usage days; red < 50 %, yellow < 80 %

coverage_table.title: Official vs observed per developer per day
coverage_table.description: connector/dql/official-vs-observed-tokens.dql — outer join on {user.email, usage.date}; a developer with no layer 2 rows shows observed = 0

freshness.title: Freshness per source
freshness.query:
fetch bizevents, from: now() - 45d
| filter event.type == "claude.usage.daily"
| filter coalesce(org.id, "") != "demo-sample"  // demo rows loaded from csv-import/sample.csv
| dedup dedup.key, sort: {timestamp desc}
| summarize {
    latest_usage_day = max(usage.date),
    latest_usage = max(toTimestamp(usage.timestamp)),
    data_refreshed_at = max(toTimestamp(data.refreshed_at)),
    last_ingest = max(timestamp),
    developers = countDistinct(user.email),
    records = count()
  }, by: {source}
| fieldsAdd lag_hours = round(toDouble(now() - latest_usage) / 3600000000000.0, decimals: 1)  // hours since the latest usage timestamp; usage.date itself is a UTC yyyy-MM-dd string: never formatTimestamp() it
| fields source, latest_usage_day, lag_hours, data_refreshed_at, last_ingest, developers, records
| sort latest_usage_day desc
freshness.description: latest usage.date, Anthropic data_refreshed_at watermark (Enterprise only) and last ingest per source — all deduped

caveats.content:
### Read me before trusting a number

* **Time picker does not apply.** Tiles filter on `usage.date` (the day the usage belongs to) with their own window, because the bizevent `timestamp` is the ingest time. Every tile dedups by `dedup.key` (newest revision wins): Anthropic revises values until ~7 days after month end and the connector re-reads recent days on purpose.
* **Amazon Bedrock is not covered** (nor Vertex AI / Foundry): Claude usage through cloud marketplaces does not appear in any Anthropic usage endpoint. Use the cloud provider's billing export for that spend.
* **Claude Team plans** have no API: rows with `source = team_csv` come from `csv-import/import_team_spend.py` (daily spend export, 1-day lag, no cache-token columns).
* **Console `product = api` rows** are org/workspace level: no e-mail, no cost (shown as null).
* **Observed coverage** compares with layer 2 (`fetch logs | filter event.name == "api_request"`), which only sees instrumented machines; expect observed ≤ official.
